text:
Ellie: FYI ingestion failed for SkyBridge hardware bundle. Their marketplace portal rejected the PO because the billingEntity doesn't match the certified seller name. Blocked on intake.
Kevin: Can you paste the rejection payload? portal usually returns a JSON error.
Ellie: Heres the snippet they sent back:
```json
{
  "po_id": "SB-PO-9876",
  "seller_name": "SkyBridge Hardware Reseller",
  "billing_entity": "Redwood Inference LLC",
  "error": "billing_entity_mismatch: expected seller_name == billing_entity"
}
```
Sam: Ugh. Their validation rule is strict: seller_name must equal billing_entity for vendor certification. Two paths: 1) ask SkyBridge to reissue PO with billing_entity=SkyBridge Hardware Reseller, or 2) provide a signed attestation from Redwood + a finance AR note to let invoices flow to Redwood while vendor remains reseller.
Maria: Finance: we cannot change master billing records mid-month. A short attestation is okay as a temporary bridge but AR needs a ticket and invoice tagging. Any attestation must include the PO ID and a statement of payment flow.
Tim (legal): I can sign a brief attestation (non-contractual) that confirms Redwood acknowledges SkyBridge Hardware Reseller as the certified vendor for PO SB-PO-9876 and authorizes payment routing. Keep it short so their procurement legal accepts it.
Jin (AR): If we go the attestation route, I need the exact wording plus a tag schema (e.g., vendor_alias:skybridge-reseller, temp_billing_flow:true) so AR automation can pick it up. Lead time: ~4 hours to process once we have the signed doc.
Daria (procurement-bot): Automated: Ingestion job SB-PO-9876 failed -> vendor_cert_mismatch. New ticket created: https://redwood.ai/ops/tickets/PROC-8122
Kevin: I'm pinging SkyBridge PM now to request PO reissue. If they can do it within the hour, that's the clean route. If not, proceed with attestation.
Ellie: Sam, can you draft the attestation text? Keep liability minimal and explicitly say it doesn't modify existing reseller terms.
Sam: Draft below. Please review: 
---
Redwood Inference Attestation (temporary billing bridge)
PO: SB-PO-9876
Redwood Inference acknowledges that SkyBridge Hardware Reseller is the certified seller for the goods and services specified in PO SB-PO-9876. For the purposes of invoicing and payment only, Redwood will accept invoices referencing Redwood Inference LLC and will remit payment to SkyBridge Hardware Reseller upon fulfillment. This attestation is non-modifying of any underlying reseller agreement and is limited to PO SB-PO-9876.
---
Tim (legal): Looks fine. Add a signature line for Legal and CEO if you think it's necessary; procurement often accepts legal + finance signoff.
Maria: Finance approves with the condition that AR gets the ticket number and the invoice tag. Jin, can you confirm processing ETA again?
Jin (AR): Confirmed. With doc + tags, we can route and clear within 4 business hours. If SkyBridge reissues PO, we can revert tags.
Kevin: Update from PM: they cannot reissue until EOD due to internal approvals. They asked if a signature from Redwood would work to unblock ingestion.
Ellie: Okay, let's move forward with attestation. Sam, finalize and Tim sign. Maria/Jin, prepare AR tag and GL mapping notes and link to PROC-8122. I'll mark ingestion job as manually reviewed to prevent auto-retry.
Daria (procurement-bot): Ticket PROC-8122 status updated -> awaiting_document_submission.
Sam: Posting final attestation doc in Confluence and assigning for signature. Link: https://redwood.ai/internal/attestations/SB-PO-9876-attestation
Ellie: Thank you everyone. I'll follow up with SkyBridge PM and post status here once signed. :thumbsup:
